button.drift: invisible coarse-pointer hit area and aria-disabled styling for disabled links (ux-guidelines.md#reach-and-touch-targets)

checkbox.drift: coarse-pointer hit area 48px wide and 40px tall, so 44px rows never overlap (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

code-block.drift: copy button takes a label, defaults to icon-sm and announces "Couldn't copy" (ux-guidelines.md#long-content-on-narrow-screens); diff lines use the --add/--del tokens (ux-guidelines.md#long-content-on-narrow-screens); the highlighter and its hook live in this dir, not the lib root (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

collapsible.drift: app-owned DisclosureTrigger, the one disclosure row (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

diff.reason: memory and skill line diff over the stock CodeBlock (ux-guidelines.md#long-content-on-narrow-screens)

dropdown-menu.drift: a CloseWatcher while open, so Android back closes the menu (ux-guidelines.md#back-gesture-and-navigation)

item.drift: bordered variant on ItemGroup for flush bordered row lists (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

native-select.drift: text-base below md like stock Input, so iOS does not zoom on focus (ux-guidelines.md#breakpoints)

page.reason: page anatomy modeled on dashboard-01 and sidebar-10/15 (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

radio-group.drift: a coarse-pointer hit area on the item (taller only in horizontal groups), and aria-labelledby pointing at its labels because axe-core skips label text inside a role=group Field (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

search.reason: the one search field over the stock InputGroup (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

sheet.drift: desktop review region (ux-guidelines.md#conversations-work-and-activity); motion duration tokens and reduced-motion override (ux-guidelines.md#motion); app-owned RoutedSheet so Android back closes it (ux-guidelines.md#back-gesture-and-navigation)

shell.reason: app shell modeled on sidebar-15 with phone gesture panes (ux-guidelines.md#breakpoints)

spinner.drift: forwards icon color props only when set so the icon keeps currentColor (ux-guidelines.md#tokens); decorative prop and reduced-motion stop (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

tabs.drift: swipe pager beside the stock parts; index re-exports raw bits-ui parts under the stock names (ux-guidelines.md#tabs-swipes-and-scroll-ownership)

trace.drift: collapsible trigger is 44px tall on coarse pointers (ux-guidelines.md#reach-and-touch-targets); no close animation, which never runs on hiddenUntilFound content, and no open animation under reduced motion (ux-guidelines.md#motion); description text at full muted-foreground for AA contrast (ux-guidelines.md#accessibility)
